initial_observation.encounter_context: presented to a dermatology clinic in Rustaq, Oman, in 2021
initial_observation.chief_complaint: multiple, itchy, pearly papules on her scalp of approximately 6 months duration
initial_observation.first_contact_summary: patient reported ulcerations and discrete bleeding after scratching due to pruritus and denied any history of systemic symptoms or local trauma; clinical examination showed multiple, grouped, erythematous papules and nodules on the left temporo-occipital region; systemic examination unremarkable without regional or systemic lymphadenopathy; prior treatments for these lesions not received
known_prior_history: no previous treatments for these lesions

evidence_items.source_text: Clinical examination of the scalp showed multiple, grouped, erythematous papules and nodules, with an average diameter of 1 cm, located on the left temporo-occipital region
A complete blood count (including eosinophils), renal function test, serum immunoglobulin E levels, HIV screening and urine analysis were all normal

Following a biopsy of one of the lesions, the histopathological examination revealed the proliferation of variable-sized blood vessels lined by plump histiocytoid endothelial cells, as well as inflammatory infiltrates comprising lymphocytes and eosinophils in the dermis [Figure 2A–E]. The biopsy also revealed evidence of Demodex mite infestation in the sebaceous ducts [Figure 2F].

The patient was treated with 10 sessions of cryotherapy (each session consisted of 2 freeze-thaw cycles per week for each lesion). In addition, twice-daily application of a topical metronidazole gel was incorporated into the treatment regimen. The patient showed remarkable clinical improvement within 7 weeks
She was subsequently followed-up for the next year with no signs of recurrence or new lesions appearing

hidden_reference.final_diagnosis_verbatim: Based on these histopathological and clinical features, a diagnosis of ALHE and scalp demodicosis was made.
diagnostic_reasoning_verbatim_spans: Following a biopsy of one of the lesions, the histopathological examination revealed the proliferation of variable-sized blood vessels lined by plump histiocytoid endothelial cells, as well as inflammatory infiltrates comprising lymphocytes and eosinophils in the dermis.
